description: Save text as a file the user can download from their Second Brain, most often a CSV: a contact list, an export, a table they want in a spreadsheet or another tool. Also .tsv, .txt, .md and .json. Files written anywhere else (a sandbox, a temp folder) are gone when you finish and the user never sees them, so this is the only way to hand over a file. Never tell the user a file is ready unless this returned saved: true. Link it in your reply as [filename](download_url).

content.description: The whole file. For a CSV, a header row then one row per line.

filename.description: The name with its extension, e.g. contacts.csv.

name: save_text_file
title: Save file
